_from: docs/plans/trader-quests/PLAN.md. Star Trader quests: 5 quest-giver portraits, a quest board and 5 story pages a quest.

styles.a: Painterly sci-fi storybook illustration, deep space blues and purples with glowing planets and warm light, cinematic, hopeful and friendly, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no writing, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.

pictures.name: quest-board
pictures.prompt: A friendly busy space station hall with a big glowing hologram noticeboard covered in little picture cards and planets, cheerful alien characters waiting nearby. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: giver-zuzu
pictures.prompt: a cheerful plump elderly woman with soft lavender skin, a human face, two small curly antennae, four arms, round glasses, a grey hair bun and a flowery apron, smiling warmly. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-vex
pictures.prompt: a tall kind but serious male starship commander with a short grey beard and a smart navy-blue uniform, calm and brave. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-sprocket
pictures.prompt: a small elderly female inventor with wild white hair, big brass goggles on her forehead and an oil-stained lab coat, excited grin. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-nettle
pictures.prompt: a tall gentle male plant-person doctor with green skin, leafy hair with one small flower, and a doctor's bag, kind smile. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: giver-kai
pictures.prompt: a friendly young woman space ranger with a green ranger jacket and short dark hair, smiling, a glowing baby space whale peeking over her shoulder. Head and shoulders portrait, centred, plain soft starry background.

pictures.name: zuzu-1
pictures.prompt: A cheerful plump elderly woman with soft lavender skin, a human face, two small curly antennae, four arms, round glasses, a grey hair bun and a flowery apron waving happily from the doorway of her cosy round house on a farm planet, party bunting. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zuzu-2
pictures.prompt: A cheerful plump elderly woman with soft lavender skin, a human face, two small curly antennae, four arms, round glasses, a grey hair bun and a flowery apron in a cosy kitchen surrounded by empty mixing bowls, looking flustered but funny, flour everywhere. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zuzu-3
pictures.prompt: A small scruffy cargo spaceship zooming off from a green farm planet, balloons and streamers trailing behind it. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zuzu-4
pictures.prompt: A joyful alien birthday party in a garden, a small boy with soft lavender skin, a human face and tiny curly antennae, holding a big purple cake and fizzing sparkle candles, little robots playing drums and guitars. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: zuzu-5
pictures.prompt: A cheerful plump elderly woman with soft lavender skin, a human face, two small curly antennae, four arms, round glasses, a grey hair bun and a flowery apron at the ramp of a small spaceship handing over a bag of coins and a slice of purple cake. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: vex-1
pictures.prompt: A tall kind but serious male starship commander with a short grey beard and a smart navy-blue uniform on a starship bridge looking at a glowing hologram of a green flower planet with small rusty pirate ships circling it. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: vex-2
pictures.prompt: A small scruffy trader spaceship in a navy hangar having a shiny blue laser cannon fitted by friendly robot arms. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: vex-3
pictures.prompt: A small brave spaceship facing three rusty patched pirate ships in a colourful nebula. Exciting, not scary. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: vex-4
pictures.prompt: Happy flower-covered villagers on a garden planet throwing flower petals into the sky as a small spaceship lands in a meadow. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: vex-5
pictures.prompt: A tall kind but serious male starship commander with a short grey beard and a smart navy-blue uniform saluting proudly in a meadow of flowers, a small spaceship behind him. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sprocket-1
pictures.prompt: A small elderly female inventor with wild white hair, big brass goggles on her forehead and an oil-stained lab coat in a messy workshop full of gadgets, pointing in shock at four empty robot charging pods. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sprocket-2
pictures.prompt: Four cute little different robots tiptoeing out of a workshop door at night carrying tiny suitcases and a beach ball. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sprocket-3
pictures.prompt: A cute little round robot peeking out of a cargo crate in a spaceship hold, looking a bit green and travel sick, funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sprocket-4
pictures.prompt: A small elderly female inventor with wild white hair, big brass goggles on her forehead and an oil-stained lab coat hugging four cute little robots in her workshop, one dripping wet, one wearing sunglasses, one lying down, one covered in glitter. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: sprocket-5
pictures.prompt: A cute little robot proudly holding up a messy crayon drawing of a spaceship, in a cosy workshop. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: nettle-1
pictures.prompt: A funny alien town where everyone is sneezing big shiny soap bubbles, bubbles floating everywhere. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: nettle-2
pictures.prompt: A tall gentle male plant-person doctor with green skin, leafy hair with one small flower, and a doctor's bag in a little clinic with empty shelves, holding up an empty medicine bottle and looking hopeful. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: nettle-3
pictures.prompt: A cosy clinic waiting room packed with hundreds of big shiny soap bubbles piled right up to the ceiling, chairs and a reception desk half hidden behind the bubbles, a few friendly aliens peeking out, funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: nettle-4
pictures.prompt: A happy alien town square, everyone well again and cheering, one round alien mayor in a sash with one tiny bubble on his nose. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: nettle-5
pictures.prompt: A tall gentle male plant-person doctor with green skin, leafy hair with one small flower, and a doctor's bag handing a bag of coins to a captain at the door of a sunny clinic, flowers around the door. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: kai-1
pictures.prompt: A cute glowing baby space whale with starry blue skin swimming right beside the round window of a small spaceship, looking lost, stars all around. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: kai-2
pictures.prompt: A long trail of glowing stardust winding across space between colourful planets. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: kai-3
pictures.prompt: A friendly young woman space ranger with a green ranger jacket and short dark hair in a cosy cockpit pointing at a glowing hologram star map, a cute glowing baby space whale with starry blue skin watching through the window. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: kai-4
pictures.prompt: A family of huge glowing space whales singing in a nebula, a cute glowing baby space whale with starry blue skin swimming into a giant hug with its mother. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: kai-5
pictures.prompt: Close-up of an open hand holding a tiny glowing whale made of shimmering starlight, space whales swimming away into a colourful nebula in the background. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: trophy-quest-master
pictures.prompt: A shining golden trophy shaped like a small star with a tiny spaceship circling it, on a soft starry background. Centred.
